subject: Recap & proposed benchmark plan — decision criteria and action items
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@auroraai.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & proposed benchmark plan — decision criteria and action items

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the test plan we discussed so we’re aligned with Aurora’s committee and timeline.

TL;DR: Your top priorities are predictable inference economics, consistent p99 latency, and an on-prem / VPC option for sensitive PII workflows. We propose a short, focused head-to-head benchmark vs two finalists (OrionML, NebulaAI) to validate latency/cost/quality tradeoffs.

Key pain points you called out
- Latency spikes at peak (affecting availability on customer chat flows).
- High token unit costs when traffic scales — hard to forecast budget.
- Need for private deployment + audit logs and SSO for regulated workflows.
- Concern about model quality drift and lack of tooling to catch regressions.

Decision criteria (Aurora-provided + what we recommend measuring)
1) Latency: 95th and 99th percentile for 1–2k concurrent sessions — target <= 150ms 95th for sample production prompts.
2) Unit economics: simulated monthly cost under your traffic profile — target <$0.0008/token for standard gen workloads.
3) Reliability & fallbacks: graceful degradation when GPU capacity constrained (automated fallback / model variant behavior).
4) Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence, retention & deletion controls, SSO/SAML, VPC connectivity.
5) Quality: automated evals against your prompt set (we’ll run Rouge/BLEU-style and human spot checks for 200 prompts).

Open questions we noted (please flag if we mis-stated)
- Exact retention window you require for logs/audit (you mentioned 90 days but procurement may ask for 365).
- Any forbidding of third-party telemetry in private deployments.
- Whether procurement requires an NDA before we share detailed runbooks/bench scripts.

Proposed test plan (high level)
- Scope: 48–72 hour microbench with three vendors (Redwood, OrionML, NebulaAI) using Aurora’s sample prompt set.
- Tests: (A) steady-state latency at defined concurrency, (B) cold-start / burst scenario, (C) simulated monthly cost run by replaying production traffic mix, (D) fault-injection to test fallbacks.
- Deliverables: raw traces, token accounting CSV, 95/99 latency graphs, short executive summary with recommendation.
- Timeline: kickoff next Tue (2026-08-10) — run 8/11–8/13 — report 8/14. If Aurora needs faster, we can compress.

Attachments: redwood_benchmark-plan-aurora.pdf (test details) and aurora_sample-prompts.csv (as submitted on call).

Next steps / asks
- Elena: confirm NDA requirement and decision committee names/emails (you mentioned Ravi and Sophie).
- Aurora: confirm retention requirement and whether a cold-start test should be included (I proposed yes below).
- Redwood: we’ll provision benchmark infra and provide endpoints + scripts. Markus will own execution and Marissa will lead quality checks.

Thanks — I’ll schedule the kickoff once we get NDA and committee confirmation.

—
Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa — thanks for the thorough note and for capturing the discussion. Couple clarifications from us:

1) Yes, NDA required before we share the rest of our test data set and production traces. Procurement sent a template earlier today; I’ll attach a signed copy if you can counter-sign.
2) Decision committee: Ravi (CTO) and Sophie (Procurement). I’ll also invite our head of security (Mateo Alvarez) to the kickoff so we can review SOC2/retention specifics.
3) Cold-start test: please include one 0->peak burst to simulate a new model variant roll-out; this is now a hard requirement.
4) Retention: procurement prefers 365 days for audit logs; security is open to 90 for tracing but wants retention policy configurable per environment.

We’ll review your attach and confirm the timeline by EOD tomorrow. Attaching the NDA routing link here: https://drive.redwood/ndas/aurora-nda-2026.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Elena
